_about: The Paladin's cards (the Paladin document, 12-paladin.md). One source per card: book/cards/README.md.

cards.name: Divine Power
cards.flavor: Your god's strength flows through your weapon and your hands.
cards.text: When you deal Holy damage to a creature with the Profane [[Tags|Tag]], that creature is Enfeebled 1 (EoT).

cards.name: Font of Mercy
cards.flavor: Where you kneel, wounds remember how to close.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, when you or an ally within 5 squares of you uses a Rally Point, they heal your Power Modifier + 2 more.

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Your weapon blazes with holy light.

versions.effects: The target sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to hide, for 1 round.
As 1 AP, but a 2 Emanation. You or one ally in the light gain +1 Defense for 1 round.
As 2 AP, and you or one ally in the light gain [[Guard]] 1d8 + [Mod]. You choose who gains the Defense and who gains the Guard separately: the same creature or two different ones.
versions.ruler: on 2+: defense 1 ally; on 2+: guard 1d8+[Mod] self

cards.name: Lay On Hands
cards.flavor: Your touch carries your god's mercy.

versions.effects: The target can use 1 Rally Point.
As 1 AP, and your next [Strike] Action deals an extra [R] 0/2d8/2d8 Ho.
versions.ruler: heal 1; always: extra 2d8 mind next strike

versions.effects: As 2 AP, but the target can use 2 Rally Points.
versions.ruler: heal 2; always: extra 2d8 mind next strike

cards.name: Holy Wrath
cards.flavor: For one blow, your god stops holding back.

cards.name: Word of Radiance
cards.flavor: You speak a word, and light pours from your hands across everything that stands against you.

cards.name: Bulwark of Faith
cards.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.
cards.target: The creature the [Strike] Action would damage (an ally)
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The target gains [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage.

foundry.append: @Guard[rally]{Guard equal to what one of their Rally Points heals}

versions.effects: As 1R, and the triggering creature is Slid 2.

foundry.append: @Guard[rally]{Guard equal to what one of their Rally Points heals}

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth, and the earth answers.

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Weapon], [Power] and [Signature] Actions, and allies in it heal 1d4 at the start of each of their turns.
versions.ruler: rounds 3 | area 2 | allies 2 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4
rounds 5 | area 2.5 | allies 2.5 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4

foundry.automationNote: the Banes and the 1d4 healing for creatures in the area (the area is placed and kept).

cards.name: Miraculous Recovery
cards.flavor: You lay both hands on the wound and call in a debt owed to your god.

versions.effects: The target heals twice what 1 Rally Point would heal, and you end one non-permanent effect of your choice on them.
As 2 AP, but three times what 1 Rally Point would heal.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.flavor: You reach out, and your god answers before you finish the prayer.
cards.interrupt: You or an ally within 5 squares would go Down.

versions.effects: Instead of going Down, the creature's total damage becomes 1 less than their Health Pool.

cards.name: Hallowed Stance
cards.flavor: You do not move. Neither do those beside you.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, if you haven't left your square since your last turn, you and your adjacent allies take less Vigor damage, reduced by your Power Modifier (minimum 0). This reduction applies to one instance of damage per Action; if the Action has several, the player chooses which one is reduced.

cards.name: Radiant Zeal
cards.flavor: The longer the fight, the brighter you burn.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage deals an extra [R] 1d6 Ho.

cards.name: Mending Light
cards.flavor: Light gathers where you stand, and the hurt are drawn to it.
cards.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, at the start of each of your turns, you or one ally within 5 squares of you heals your Power Modifier + 1.

foundry.append: (Not automated: heal the creature you choose by hand.)

cards.name: Aura of Protection
cards.flavor: You plant your feet, and light rims the shoulders of everyone near you.
cards.target: You and allies in the Area

versions.effects: Until the end of the encounter, you and allies in the Aura gain +1 Defense.

cards.name: Divine Surge
cards.flavor: You name the foe in your god's sight, and every blade that finds it burns.

versions.effects: For 1 round, the next time an ally deals damage to the target, they deal an extra [R] 1d8 Ho. You gain [[Guard]] 2d6.
versions.ruler: always: surge 1d8 mind; always: guard 2d6 self

foundry.automationNote: the ally clicks the button on the mark for the extra [R] 1d8 Ho.

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards.flavor: A shimmer of light holds steady between them and harm.
cards.target: The creature the Strike would damage (you or an ally)
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage you or an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The damage that Strike deals to the target is reduced by 1d8 + your Power Modifier.

cards.name: Hand of Mercy
cards.flavor: A single touch undoes what the enemy worked for.

versions.effects: Choose one: the ally ends one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left; or, if the ally is Down, they can use 1 Rally Point.

foundry.automationNote: ending the effect (the Rally Point button works).
